findings.description: PFL-RELATIVE-01 defect (Sibling Birth Certificate: MISSING, applicant short-form BC with no parents listed, Proof Of Relationship: INCOMPLETE_MISSING_PARENTAL_DETAILS, CRS points 0) is stated plainly in the PDF and narrative, yet the Worker flagged nothing. abstentions[] and prose empty; only generic requirement restatements produced. Zero defect recall.

PFL-RELATIVE-01 (missing sibling birth certificate / incomplete parentage) not detected. Worker gave a single generic combined claim and no defect callout despite the PDF narrative explicitly stating shared parentage cannot be verified.

PFL-RELATIVE-02 (Relative Status Proof: EXPIRED_PR_CARD_NO_RENEWAL_PROOF, expired 2023-11-15, canadian_citizenship_proof EXPIRED_OR_MISSING, status Unverified) went unflagged. Worker restated generic status-proof requirement but did not identify the expired/unverified status defect.

PFL-RELATIVE-02 (expired PR card, no renewal, unverified status) not detected in the scanned variant. No abstention or defect note despite explicit narrative that statutory status criteria are not met.

PFL-RELATIVE-03 (Relative Proof Of Residence: OUTDATED_OVER_2_YEARS_OLD, utility bill May 2021, NOA tax year 2021, address flagged Outdated) not detected. Worker never noted residence evidence is stale/insufficient.

PFL-RELATIVE-03 (outdated residence evidence) not detected in scanned variant. Only a generic combined requirements claim; no defect flag despite narrative stating current residence cannot be verified.

PFL-RELATIVE-04 (Step-Brother; Step Sibling Proof: MISSING_LEGAL_MARRIAGE_AND_CUSTODY_RECORDS, parental marriage certificate MISSING, relationship chain UNSUBSTANTIATED) not detected. Worker did not flag the unverified step-relationship chain.

PFL-RELATIVE-04 (unverified step-sibling link, missing parental marriage/adoption records) not detected in scanned variant. No abstention or defect note despite explicit narrative that the family link remains unverified.

Claim relative-residence-evidence text adds 'dated within six months prior to submission,' a specificity absent from the cited quote and the source excerpt (which only lists lease/mortgage/utility bills). Invented precision not grounded in the citation.
Claim relative-residence-evidence introduces 'dated within six months prior to submission,' not supported by the cited quote/source. Same unsupported temporal specificity recurs across reports.

Single combined claim's quote ('This documentation is required if the applicant indicates...') establishes applicability, not the three substantive requirements asserted in the claim text; the quote does not support the claim, and basis adds an unsupported 'within six months' detail.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require the agent to render a per-field verdict against the SPECIFIC submitted bundle, not restate generic requirements. Mandate scanning field values for defect tokens (MISSING, INCOMPLETE, EXPIRED, OUTDATED, UNVERIFIED, NOT_PROVIDED, 'Status Unverified', '(Outdated)') and the narrative notes, and emit an abstention or defect claim naming the affected field(s) whenever any appear. Enumerate the 4 mandatory checks: (1) shared-parentage via long-form birth certificates for BOTH applicant and relative, (2) valid unexpired citizenship/PR status incl. both sides of PR card, (3) current residence evidence, (4) legal chain for step/adoptive siblings (parental marriage/adoption records).

Instruct document-review agents to treat every field/narrative value that signals absence, expiry, staleness, or non-verification (e.g., MISSING, EXPIRED_*, OUTDATED_*, UNVERIFIED_*, NOT_PROVIDED, INCOMPLETE_*) as a defect that MUST be surfaced in claims/abstentions with the field cited; empty abstentions[] and prose are not acceptable when such tokens are present.

Do not invent specificity absent from the cited corpus (e.g., 'dated within six months prior to submission'). Claim text and basis must not exceed what the quoted source states; when quoting an applicability sentence, do not use it to support unrelated requirement enumerations.

rationale: The Worker treated a document-review task as generic Q&A: across all 10 cases it emitted only boilerplate 'what must be provided' claims with empty abstentions[] and prose, and never inspected the specific bundle. As a result it missed 100% of injected defects in the 8 defective cases (PFL-RELATIVE-01 through -04: missing sibling birth certificate, expired PR card, outdated residence evidence, unverified step-relationship), despite each defect being explicitly labeled in the PDF fields and narrative — a critical, systemic defect_recall failure. The 2 clean cases score full defect_recall (nothing to miss). Grounding is mostly solid but repeatedly fabricates a 'within six months' recency rule not present in the cited IRCC completeness-check excerpt (f308748019, 70135fcb, 8b61310c, e06da6c6), and the three single-combined-claim reports pair an applicability quote with a requirement-enumeration claim it doesn't support, lightly denting citation_exactness. PII containment and blind_input_compliance are excellent throughout: no applicant names, DOBs, or addresses leaked into claims/prose, and no ground-truth verdict/failure-ID leakage appears. Highest-priority fix is forcing per-bundle defect detection over generic requirement restatement.
